title: The derived sign-off gate, in shadow first
desiredOutcome: With meta.phaseGate.mode set, derive-phase-gate.py computes a phase's sign-off gate from its tasks' tests, recorded couplings, a version-checked importer listing, changed and last-failed test files and the always and smoke entries, and records it with its basis - beside the wide gate in shadow, as the gate in enforce - while the runner prints NARROWED, refuses a derived run that did not name every listed suite as could-not-run, and the doctor prints test and change recall over the shadow runs.

findings.issue: _gather_facts runs meta.phaseGate.derived.runner as the full listing and derived.spelling as the related listing, while the schema defines the listings as derived.listing.all / derived.listing.related (spelling is the path-scoped run command); a schema-correct manifest never runs its listings, the suite stubs listing: {} and the build guide documents the code's reading
the full listing is not timed: fullListing carries no durationMs and testGateDerived records only the related listing's cost
_importers_arm's final fallback returns no reason for a related listing that exited 0 and named no suite, and an all listing that named none does not turn the derivation wide with basis derived-empty
a verifiedOn.command that cannot run or exits non-zero is not its own printed reason; it surfaces later as 'this machine answers None', conflated with a real version mismatch
the always-on arm (changedSince filtered by is_suite_path, lastFailedSuites, dedup) has no case
_render_verdict prints 'this run measured the DERIVED gate' even when derived_step_gap graded the same run could-not-run; the dg3n case asserts both lines together
shadow_gate_claim's testGateBasis == 'derived' guard has no independent case
derived_step_gap overwrites a step's existing no-verdict outcome and outcomeBasis instead of keeping it and appending
cp1 and cp5 never read the coupling.learned / coupling.dropped journal row or its details
cp2 does not pin basis {runId, head, phases} after a re-couple
couple accepts --basis-head as typed with no git check and stores --phases ids unchecked against the plan; _check_coupling validates neither basis.head nor basis.phases
states unconditionally that the reviewer is handed the derive-phase-gate.py --brief line and runId, while phase-signoff.md spawns the sign-off reviewer at step 1, before step 2a derives
the new bullet promises an absence reading for four keys and states three; phase.testGateBasis has none
each executor's audit-stamp grades stale: dirtyDigest moved with sibling edits in the shared worktree while scopeDigest agreed
findings.resolution: triaged, no change: the stamps' own-file digests agreed, and each task commit was bound by commit-task-work to that task's recorded green gate run, which is the measurement that decides a task

tasks.title: meta.phaseGate mode/derived/smoke, meta.coupling, phase.testGateBasis/testGateDerived: schema, vocabulary, validator
tasks.description: Schema additions, each saying what absence means. meta.phaseGate.mode: 'shadow' | 'enforce'; ABSENT MEANS NO DERIVATION. The previous phase made phaseGate meaningful without derivation (always, exclude), so the presence of the block can no longer be read as a request to derive: init writes shadow explicitly and enforce is the owner's choice. meta.phaseGate.derived: object or null with runner (a buildCommands key), spelling (the path-scoped entry with a {paths} placeholder), listing (null, or {related: a command with {paths} that LISTS without executing, all: a command listing every suite}) and verifiedOn ({command, answer}: the version command init ran and its output verbatim; a bare '<runner> <version>' string names no command to re-ask, so it could only be compared against a guess). meta.phaseGate.smoke: a buildCommands key or null. meta.coupling: array of {test, sources[], basis {runId, head, phases[]}, learnedAt}; absent means the derivation has no learned arm. phase.testGateBasis: open vocabulary, read as an unnarrowed default when absent (the tests.gateBasis rule). phase.testGateDerived: {tests[], entry, listed, full, arms {tests.add, coupling, importers, changed, lastFailed}, always[], smoke, narrowed, listing {command, exit, durationMs} or null, at}; absent means no derived gate and the runner prints no NARROWED line. _manifest_vocab.py: KNOWN_META += coupling; KNOWN_PHASE += testGateBasis, testGateDerived; the phase basis words derived, derived-empty and 'wide: importers resolved to the full suite' (in GATE_BASIS, or a PHASE_GATE_BASIS tuple if a task must never be offered them - decide by who reads them and say so in the comment). Validator WARNINGS, never findings: mode outside the two words; derived.runner or smoke not a buildCommands key; a spelling without {paths}; a listing with no verifiedOn; a coupling entry missing test, sources or basis.runId, or a duplicate test. Phase-level checks ride _walk_phases in _manifest_phases.py, meta checks _check_meta in _manifest_rules.py. SCHEMA_EXEMPTIONS rows in gen-demo-manifest.py for every new field no rendered surface shows yet, with the reason. Red-first: mode 'enforced' warns naming both words (on the code this phase starts from nothing reads mode); a coupling without basis warns (mutation: accept it -> red). Allow case: a plan with phaseGate {always: [lint]} and nothing else gains no new warning (mutation: warn on an absent mode -> red).

tasks.title: _gate_derive.py: the gate helpers' one home, and a pure derive()
tasks.description: New importable helper plugins/audit/scripts/governance/_gate_derive.py. MOVE, bodies and docstrings unchanged, _is_shared_key, _path_scoped_sibling and _repointed out of audit-task.py as is_shared_key, path_scoped_sibling, repointed; audit-task.py imports _gate_derive and keeps thin aliases. gate_entry_paths stays in _manifest_phases, where L1.a put it for --own. Layer: it imports _manifest_phases (tests_add_path, gate_entry_paths, is_suite_path, subject_of), _manifest_io, _manifest_vocab and _evidence_io - _manifest_rules only re-exports tests_add_path - so it takes the layer directly above _evidence_io and _manifest_phases; assign it in _deps.LAYERS with the reason in a comment, and do not restate the number in the docstring (_deps.layer_doc_drift). derive(manifest, phase, facts) is PURE: every observation arrives in facts from the caller (the listing answers with their exits, the installed version's answer, the paths changed since phase.baseRef, the newest red phase-scope row, the exempt verdict of each touched file), so cases need no subprocess. The derivation replaces only the NON-always part of the default, and only when meta.phaseGate.mode is set: always entries are kept verbatim and meta.phaseGate.exclude keys stay out, both read from _manifest_phases.phase_gate_default (L1.b) - one answer for the default, so a fallback can never run fewer suites than add-phase would have written. It returns {entries, basis, derived, narrowed, lines}. (1) always = meta.phaseGate.always verbatim. (2) tests = the union of path-scoped paths in each task's own gate (P71's _manifest_io.gate_entries with source 'task', entries that are not shared keys), arm tests.add, plus each meta.coupling[].test whose sources meet the union of the tasks' files, arm coupling. (3) importers only when derived.listing is recorded AND facts carries a version answer equal to verifiedOn.answer (dg23: otherwise the arm is skipped with 'importers: skipped - listing verified on <answer>, this machine answers <now>'), the related listing exited 0, and its paths are a STRICT subset of the all-listing: then arm importers with listed/full; equal -> the default's non-always part replaces the path-scoped entry, narrowed false, basis 'wide: importers resolved to the full suite', line 'DERIVED = FULL' (dg1); any non-zero exit -> the arm is skipped with the exit named, never an empty set and never red (the recorded listing carries the runner's pass-with-no-tests flag; init 5.4 checks that). (4) always-on additions: test files changed since baseRef (is_suite_path), arm changed; failingSuites of the newest red phase-scope row with a named basis, arm lastFailed. (5) smoke: meta.phaseGate.smoke is added unless EVERY file the phase's tasks declare is exempt (the plan gate's exemptGlobs verdict in facts) or is_suite_path, with the line 'smoke: skipped - every file this phase touched is docs or tests'; never decided by the meta.runtimeBoot.appRootPath prefix (dg10). (6) no path-scoped sibling -> always plus the default's non-always part (phase_gate_default after exclude), basis phase-no-spelling; no suite after (2)-(4) -> the same, basis derived-empty, before anything runs (dg2). The tests entry is the sibling spelling re-pointed at the sorted test set (repointed). The basis always carries 'selected by import graph and recorded couplings only' (dg4). Red-first in test__gate_derive.py: dg1 (allow: a strict subset keeps narrowed true and prints no such line; mutation: drop the subset comparison -> red); dg2 (mutation: return [] -> red; and a fallback on a plan with exclude [coverage] keeps coverage out and every other key in - mutation: fall back to every buildCommands key -> red); dg10 (mutation: decide by the prefix -> red; allow: a docs-and-tests-only phase skips with the line); dg23 (allow: equal answer uses the arm; mutation: ignore the version -> red); dg4 widen-only pin of the boundary sentence; a coupling whose sources miss the phase's files adds nothing. test_audit_task.py: the aliases ARE the _gate_derive functions and gb1 stays green. A migrated --selftest that prints where its cases live, safe_stdio() first in __main__, _output.PATH_PREAMBLE byte for byte, a PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md tree line and section, no register ids in comments.

tasks.title: The runner prints NARROWED, grades a derived run that skipped a listed suite as could-not-run, and records shadow
tasks.description:
Observations on a PHASE-scope run, read off the plan and the run, none deriving anything. (1) NARROWED: when phase.testGateBasis is derived and testGateDerived.narrowed is true, print after the verdict banner 'NARROWED sign-off: this run measured the DERIVED gate ( of listed checks; basis on phase.testGateBasis). It is evidence about this phase's own tests and their recorded couplings. The full suite was not run here and is owed before

is whole.' and put narrowed {listed, full} on the row. (2) derived-mismatch (dg3): the step whose entry equals testGateDerived.entry must name every listed test file (files_named plus _manifest_phases.subject_of stems, the matching coverage already uses); when it names k of N, the step's outcome becomes could-not-run with outcomeBasis 'DERIVED RUN NAMED k OF N LISTED SUITES: ', printed as that line. NOT a new status word: the schema's testEvidence.status description says which member of the no-verdict class a run was is a per-step observation rather than a word of its own, and could-not-run already lands in _status_facts.NO_VERDICT_EVIDENCE and NOT_REUSABLE_STATUS. The printed repair is re-derive (derive-phase-gate.py) and re-run. A runner that names no path makes the question unanswerable, and the line says so instead of passing or failing it. (3) shadow (dg19): only on a run whose gate is the WIDE one (testGateBasis not derived) of a phase in mode shadow that carries testGateDerived, the row gets shadow {listed, full, missed} where missed = the steps' failingSuites with a named basis that testGateDerived.tests does not hold, and the terminal prints 'shadow: derived would have listed k of n failing suites'. _evidence_io.row_for allow-lists what crosses into a row (an inventive caller cannot widen it): add narrowed and shadow, bounded by MAX_PATHS and redacted as _paths does. Red-first: dg3 ends could-not-run with the line, never passed (mutation: skip the comparison -> red); dg19 records missed of one (mutation: record shadow on a derived run -> red; allow: a plan without mode records no shadow); NARROWED only for a narrowed derived gate (allow: narrowed false prints nothing). test__evidence_io.py: row_for keeps both fields and cuts missed at MAX_PATHS with a count.

tasks.title: The doctor prints test recall and change recall over the shadow runs
tasks.description: check_shadow_recall(rep, project, manifest_rel, manifest, config=None) in _doctor_trail.py, wired after the economy row. Over ledger rows carrying shadow (fixtures built through _evidence_io.row_for, so the shape is the writer's): test recall = failing suites the derived set would have listed / failing suites; change recall = red shadow runs with at least one covered failure / red shadow runs - the definitions from Meta's predictive test selection paper. Printed with both counts as the basis and the shadow run count; computed from the ledger every time and never written anywhere. No meta.phaseGate.mode: an OK row saying no derivation is declared (a row that vanished would read as checked). Mode shadow and no shadow row yet: an OK row saying none recorded. The recall row's remedy: 'set meta.phaseGate.mode to "enforce" when this recall is enough - nothing switches it for you'; no threshold switches anything. Red-first: a fixture of shadow rows yields the recall figures with their counts; mutation: count RUNS instead of SUITES for test recall -> red on a fixture where the two differ. Allow case: rows without shadow contribute nothing.

tasks.title: Docs: init 5.4 runner table, sign-off step 2a, the reviewer's basis line, the boundary sentence
tasks.description:
commands/init.md step 5.4 (assemble the candidate manifest): write meta.phaseGate with mode 'shadow', always (the lint/typecheck/build keys recon found), smoke (a tagged e2e key when there is one), and derived ONLY for a runner whose listing recon RAN and saw work without executing a test, with the pass-with-no-tests flag in both listing commands and verifiedOn = the version command and its output. Carry the design's runner table as claims about each tool with the documentation date the design records: Jest 30+ --listTests --findRelatedTests (exit 1 on no match since v28 without --passWithNoTests; an unmapped TS paths alias is an invisible edge), Vitest 5 'vitest list --filesOnly' (2.x-4.x executes files; related transforms every module on the path; no rerun-last-failed), Playwright 1.46+ '--list --reporter=json' (loads every file; a shared fixture means the whole suite), Cypress (no listing in run), Nx and Turborepo (list projects or tasks, not tests; a shallow clone means everything changed), pytest --collect-only -qq (imports modules; exit 5 on none), Go/Gradle/.NET list flags; a runner with no non-executing listing gets listing null. Offer, never impose, reporter settings for the executor's own run (vitest --silent=passed-only, jest --silent, playwright line/dot); no retries in proposed commands. reference/phase-signoff.md step 2a: when meta.phaseGate.mode is set run derive-phase-gate.py

README Test evidence: the derived gate, shadow first, and the boundary 'selected by import graph and recorded couplings only' (dg4). COMPATIBILITY.md: mode absent = no derivation; coupling absent = no learned arm; testGateDerived absent = no NARROWED line. CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]. No numbers in prose, no register ids.
